description: This Java class implements the loan lifecycle state machine for managing loan status transitions within the Fineract platform, including methods for determining and executing state changes based on loan events and current status.

classes.name: DefaultLoanLifecycleStateMachine
classes.description: Implements the logic for transitioning loan statuses based on various loan events, handling complex state transitions, and notifying other components of status changes.

methods.name: dryTransition
methods.description: Predicts the next loan status based on a given event without applying the transition.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Executes a state transition for a loan based on a given event.

methods.name: determineAndTransition
methods.description: Determines the appropriate transition based on current loan status and transaction date, then applies it if needed.

methods.name: internalTransition
methods.description: Performs the internal logic of transitioning a loan's status and updates related fields.

methods.name: getNextStatus
methods.description: Determines the next loan status based on the current status and event.
